visual.title: The dual reads the same optimum
visual.caption: The dual value is b times the multipliers. With b = (4, 5) and multipliers (1/3, 4/3), the dual value is 8, exactly the primal optimum, so the gap is zero.

predict.question: What is the dual objective value at the optimum?
predict.explain: 4 times 1/3 plus 5 times 4/3 equals 8. The dual value matches the primal optimum, so strong duality holds and the gap is zero.
